title: Floppy Did This
synopsis: Floppy Did This is a fun and simple story designed for beginner readers. Join Biff, Chip, Kipper, and their lovable dog Floppy in this engaging tale where Floppy gets up to a little mischief around the house. As the children try to find out who is causing all the mess, young readers will enjoy predicting the story and learning new words through repetition and picture cues.
